latest_messages.headline: Week ending Oct 30: -0.57% | SPY -0.54% | alpha -0.03% | grade B
latest_messages.body: Honest week report-card: after three straight weekly wins, we TIED the market this week -- we slipped -0.57% and so did the S&P 500 (-0.54%), finishing a whisker behind. No spin: the streak is over. The week was two-sided -- the Mon-Wed rally-into-the-Fed is our weak spot (our steady defensive stocks don't climb as fast on up days), so we fell behind, then Thu-Fri's selloff is where we shine (Friday us -0.80% vs market -1.79%) and we clawed back to even. The real win was risk management on ResMed: I trimmed half on Monday to lock +10% BEFORE its earnings, it then gapped ~6% lower, and our safety net sold the rest Friday -- net +$518 for the week instead of giving it back. No rules changed: one tie after three beats is noise, not a reason to tinker. Monday I'll look for a clean buy for the open slot -- only if something good is on sale. Equity $99,038; $20,674 cash (~21%).
